title: The Lion and the Clever Hare

characters.name: Lion
characters.description: a massive tawny lion with a dark mane, fierce eyes, muscular build — the bloodthirsty king of this forest

characters.name: Hare
characters.description: a small brown hare with large ears and bright alert eyes, slender and quick — clever and unafraid

scenes.narration: A bloodthirsty lion terrorized the forest, killing animals every single day.
Terrified, the animals agreed to send one of their own to the lion's den each day to save themselves.
When it was the hare's turn, he did not weep — instead he devised a clever plan to outwit the lion.
The hare arrived at the den late, bowing apologetically.

dialogue.speaker: Hare
dialogue.line: Great Lion, forgive me! Another lion blocked my path and ate my meal first. I barely escaped with my life.

scenes.narration: The lion's fury flared — another lion dared challenge his throne?

dialogue.speaker: Lion
dialogue.line: Another lion? Show me this rival at once, or you shall be my next meal!

scenes.narration: The hare led him to a deep well in the old ruins and pointed down into the still water.

dialogue.speaker: Hare
dialogue.line: Right here, Great Lion. Look into the well — he hides within and mocks you.

scenes.narration: The lion peered into the water and saw only his own reflection staring back at him.
Thinking it was a true rival, the lion let out a deafening roar and leapt into the deep well to attack — meeting his end at once.

dialogue.speaker: Lion
dialogue.line: I will teach you to challenge me!

scenes.narration: From that day on, the forest was at peace — and wits had conquered brute force.
